title: Walnut Banana Bread
summary: A moist, gently spiced banana bread studded with walnuts and baked until golden. It makes a comforting dessert or an afternoon treat with tea or coffee.
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line a 2 lb loaf tin with baking paper.
In a bowl, mix the flour, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda, salt and cinnamon.
In a separate large bowl, mash the bananas until mostly smooth, then whisk in the melted butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla extract.
Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until no dry flour remains, then stir in most of the walnuts.
Pour the batter into the prepared tin and scatter the remaining walnuts over the top.
Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, until the loaf is risen, golden, and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean.
Leave to cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then lift out and cool completely before slicing.
